text:
anna-finance: Heads up — Acme Inc (acct 9432) just escalated: their AP rejected our invoice PDF. Reason: missing 'Company Reg No' in the billing block and PO number not shown in the header. They're refusing payment until fixed. Ticket CS-9042, customer on hold.

raj-support: Can you paste the exact PDF excerpt they attached? even a screenshot text is fine.

anna-finance: Here’s the snippet they sent (copied):

```
ACME INC
123 Dockside Ave
London, E1 6AN
VAT: GB999999973
--
Invoice #: RWI-2024-1156
Date: 2025-03-04
PO: 
Company Reg No: 
```

morgan-billing: ugh. Looks like our current template uses optional vars and if empty we render blank lines. AP requirements: PO must appear in the top-right and Company Reg No must be labeled and populated under the legal entity block. They also need line-item VAT breakdown per line (rate + VAT amount).

julia-legal: Confirming: for UK/EU customers we must include company registration number (Companies House) and VAT ID in the header for legal invoices. Placement matters for their AP parser. Also ensure our "legal_entity_name" uses the full registered name, not the shortname.

sophie-ops: Quick triage: probable cause = PDF template variable mapping for accounts with multiple legal entities. When org has no reg number on file we leave blank; here Acme provided info but our ingestion didn’t attach it due to a mapping bug. I can patch template to hide labels when blanks OR better: always show label and fallback to "Provided on PO" only if truly missing. Thoughts?

morgan-billing: We need label always + populate when available. Customer demanded backfill for last 2 months or they'll escalate to legal. Can we regenerate PDFs for invoices RWI-2024-1120..1156?

raj-support: Repro steps I used:
1) Create acct with legal_entity.shortname="Acme" and legal_entity.registered_name="Acme Incorporated" but omit reg_number.
2) Generate invoice via API POST /invoices -> invoice PDF omits reg_number label.
3) Patch payload to include reg_number and re-generate -> label appears.

sophie-ops: Thanks. I'll take ownership of template changes + regen script. Plan:
- PR to replace conditional block with explicit label: `Company Reg No: {{legal_entity.reg_number | default: "(not provided)"}}`
- Add PO field to header: `PO: {{invoice.po_number}}` and ensure it's required for enterprise invoices via validation.
- Backfill job: regenerate PDFs for invoice list and attach to billing history.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch fix/finance/pdf-legal-reg-2025 (CI: running).

morgan-billing: Please add unit test for template rendering for empty vs provided reg_number and PO. Also add a migration note for backfill.

julia-legal: Approve change to show label even when missing, as long as wording is clear. If we insert "(not provided)" that’s fine. For backfill, redacted PII rules still apply.

anna-finance: Priority HIGH. Sophie, ping me when PR is ready and share a quick diff snippet so I can update the customer. If backfill will take >24h we should send a temporary workaround (signed CSV with reg no + PO) to Acme AP. :pray:

sophie-ops: Will open PR in ~30m and start backfill queue after deploy completes. I'll post status here.

raj-support: Thanks — I'll add repro notes to CS-9042 and CC customer success for notifications.
